composition_notes: A lilting dotted cell and gently repeated bass create a pastoral compound-duple movement.
A step-directed upper melody replaces repeated chord-rank patterns while preserving the lilting dotted rhythm; a few weak passing links animate the bass.
The score records each added suspension and scalar connection explicitly for teaching.
The free preludes are reviewed for note integrity, spelling, harmonic context and the listed voice-leading changes; they are not advertised as strict-species exercises.
